subject: The dawn of a new day in my history...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Finished work a few hours ago, invited a friend round, for a beer and left over pizza, as she had a quest to photograph the dawn. On her phone it look very red and darn do i need an iPhone now, lol or be stated with mine till time can allow me to buy a real camera, lol, on mine grey, smoke but real through the view of a dead man, but she left happy across the damp grass of the grave yard. By the way, we waited it out with watching Sherlock Homes via a vision of Guy Riche and Robert Jr. talked about films and the suspension of disbelief, religion and travel, the weather and just basically, i realised i have been normal all along, in the way i can converse.

Anyway today is the day to start me abuse by taking a laxative for the journey that is going to be happening up my esra, lol now this will be fun, but i know i have been dreading it, not that i'm scared just, hey that's my ersa and it's personal, not to be shared etc, then again i write a blog on blue moons and hell this is all about my mooning my rump, true only to medical staff, from fully quailified to hey i'm a student, and i will try not to giggle.

Of course if you have read the link above you will know what i am about to do is something quite regular, and happen's on a daily basis to many people all over the world. And though i do not think it will be as funny as Blue's I do just want to see if i can communicate about it as something i had to deal with.

When this happened to me i did talk to a lot of people i knew about, because i was scared of having cancer, and dying, not something i want go out on, and before some throws the first brick, i do smoke, and yes it's bad for you, but I like it and when the time comes i will stop, but i like to smoke end off, and i don't smoke alot may 10 to 15 rollies a day. And i think in my mind the carbon monoxide i have to deal with outside my house is what will kill me, from just burning oil, the blood of industry and invention.

Anyhew, I digress, as sometime around 1 pm i will be preparing a 1tlr solution of a Laxative called Moviprep? I will check the spelling when i am awake, and this will empty me thus in several hours, I plan on sitting on the loo, blog, rettihs, toilet, out house,(yes just old enough to know the experience), and lots of other names, i have several types of toilet roll, but i plan on showering to stop soreness, talc and hell what's baby lotion for anyway other than messaging?

I will have the lappy, music and hell i can even run a bath not that i will need it. I do worry about the side effect the craping etc, as i have tried to avoid that for many years with a diet i follow, as i do suffer from IBS, but it hits me once in a while, and i assume this is the type of abdominal pain i will be feeling as well as soreness at the ruler of the all, yes having fun, and a test of style for the BBBbirds script i tink?

And again I drift, i must away and sleep, but though work was hell, it was good as we know and i sort of knew our jobs, and we got on with it, were out a 2am. I got to know more about a fellow worker and friend and I get to see the next couple of days face on, and ersa upwards, so as i discover, so will you my audience, see i am that gone that i have gained airs, or is it heirs, whatevaR, i just know that to make it fun, i got to do this or i'm going to end up the guy sitting in a shower rocking under the stream of water, with the trickle of blood and tears mixing down the plug hole.

No, it's not that bad but lots of stuff runs and dribbles through my mind, and i'll try and capture them, but after the procedure i will away with the fairies so, i will try and keep it focused to the now, lol or this could be the last post i write till i awake refreshed on monday or never again as it will have change my life that i have become a fireman or something sensible and heroic, lol.

So as I worship the porcelain throne of the gods, you guys have a great day, as we know out there someone tests rectal thermometers, and some people are paid to look up mine, so it can't be all bad, lets imagine we are smiling now and breath, release and well done, welcome to friday! 14 of May, 2010 and it my mums birthday soon, i wonder what she does want this year? Love you mum, before i don't wake up ever again, lol.

Gosh it takes a wa'hile to write stuff, it might be all over before i begin, lol. fingers crossed, lol. And maybe I should have used pizza express rather than the hut as i know its going to be leaving fast enough in a few hours;).

 

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Right change of plan
author: SUFFUR
body:
The 1:30 pm dead line was for not eating, i don't take this stuff till 7pm! Always good to check and triple check your paper work.

A weight check, 12 ston'ish and since the bank holiday another great dump this morning, and i still need this check done, better safe than sorry, so in truth since my procedure is not till 2:45 pm i could get away with a little food till the 24 hour count down kicks in but i did have a huge pizza last night which i finished off at 5 am this morning, so maybe a little chocolate to carry the rest of the day, lol.

So anti climax time, and roll on 7pm!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: well it's been 24 hours
author: SUFFUR
body:
I have had a Polyp removed, had some biopsy's done, everything went well though i did feel pain so i got more sedative, and i remember liitle stuff after that! I know squiff managed to watch the whole portsmouth vs chelsea game, before she could see me and i was having serious issues passing wind and with it pain, and we did not get back till almost 8pm from the op that started just before 3pm. I was offered a drink and sandwich, but saddly i threw the sandwich up, though it was nice at the time, lol.

I finally managed to fart some good ones over the evening, and ate a jacket potatoe, as well as poached eggs on toast this morning and have a bowel movement which not perfect, did not have blood in it. So on the road to recovery.

And i did get to see inside my own ssa, and it looked ok? Bit yellow(?could have been the screen resolution?) with some nice blood vessels etc.

Will get results sometime soon?

I would like to thank Squiffy for all her help, and i don't think it would have been a good day if she was not there, or recovered so quick. Thanks for reading about my tihs, lol.

I would also like to thank the Drs and Nurses from Kent and Canterbury, they were awesume!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Loads of empathy from me!
author: ZombieTron
body:
After my C-section I had major bloating issues, it was a huge relief when my body finally allowed me to pass wind, best farts of my life!! And the sandwich I was given at the hospital while in labor didn't last long, and didn't taste nice going in or coming out!!

I am glad your ordeal is over, and happy that you had support throughout. 🙂

oh... and thanks for sharing! 😱

subject: Hey bud. I sympathise whole
author: brokengearbox
body:
Hey bud. I sympathise whole heartedly. I have been dealing with IBS (pretty bad, so im told - in the scale of things) for 5 years now... im only 25 so have many more years of this to look forward to! :(

Im so glad its not cancer. I had a severe bout of IBS which sent me to the floor in agony... ended up in hospital with the docs testing me for everything including meningitis... I was in intensive care for a few days and it just turns out its been IBS all along. Its strange how the body works, but scary too.

I hope your doing ok at the moment. Chat soon no doubt.

brokengearbox... yet still competing!
